_: The town shows the realm's state in its streets (town_life.gd _moods; docs/TUNING.md). The state is the bridge's (each city's atWar, famine, celebrating in /world, and the muster scene for a levy, read through works.gd states); this only says how it looks. A state's row: stalls_open (the share of market stalls still kept: the rest stand shut, no keeper, no buyers), rack (swords on the armoury rack when it starts), hammer (how fast the smiths swing, times their own pace), grief (a death mourned at the town: stalls_open, out (the share of its people still about), candles and flowers set round the centrepiece, black cloth over the doors of the houses nearest the square, the bell tolling every toll seconds), dole (a famine: the dole table, at which of the town's places), feast (bonfire: its flames, the fire's own flame shader (fire.gd): how many, how big, how fast they rise, and its light's strength and reach; tables: long tables set in the square, seats a side; bunting: lines of pennants from a pole by the well out to poles round the square, height in metres, flags a line, sag in metres; colours: the house's, then these). A court ruling standing at the town (the bridge's rulings.js) is a state too, and the herald cries it in the square with listeners cheering or dismayed (works.json counts.listeners, weights): relief (Manor Lords' market approval: goods heaped as in good times; the buyers are the villagers at the stalls), justice (Stronghold's gallows and CK3's dread: an empty gallows at the square's seen edge, guards and a silent crowd, from_well out), grant (CK3's granted holding: the house's banners round the square, ring out, and a building site for it, site a Freeciv building name read as its kit, progress risen), build (Manor Lords' works: the ordered work's site with its builders). Who stands in these scenes and how many (the muster and the levy's march out, the funeral, the dole's line, the gallows' crowd and guards) is town_scenes.json's (standing rows); this file says what the town looks like.
_centre: Round the square's centrepiece (a fountain at a seat; towns.gd root meta centrepiece, its real footprint): how far past its basin's rim things stand (game units). mourners: the grief's kneelers (and anyone set down near the heart: the levy's kin, dogs, children); stall: a good year's extra stall by the well (its canopy); candles: their candles set down; bunting: the feast's tall pole; fire: the feast's bonfire (past its own heat too), moved off the heart to the seen side, its dancers and tables round it.
_pile_full: pile_full: how full each stall's pile of goods stands as the town is dressed (town_life.gd _pile; its most is crowd.json square_agents.pile.most), the least over the town's states that set it, else crowd.json square_agents.pile.full: bare in hunger, thin when lean or the granary low, piled high on market day, at a fair, in good times and with autumn's stores in.

rebels._: A town the rebels hold in a rising (bridge risings.js): half the market shut, the rest trading under the claimant's men.

loyal._: A town its lord still holds in a rising: stalls shut against the trouble.

sullen._: A town whose lord is angry with the King (works.gd sullen): a third of its stalls shut.

devoted._: A town whose lord is loyal to the King (works.gd devoted, town_dress/devoted.gd): bunting over its square in the house's colour and these (cream, gold), fewer lines than a feast's.
